results.prompt: `npm test` fails in this project. Find the bug in the source code and fix it so the whole test suite passes. Do not change the tests.
results.reply:
I fixed the bug in `formatCents` in `src/money.ts`. It printed the cents part without padding, so 500 came out as `$5.0` instead of `$5.00`, and 305 as `$3.5`. It now pads the cents to two digits with `padStart(2, '0')`.

`npm test` now passes all 6 tests, including the negative-amount one. I didn't touch the tests.

results.prompt: Configuration in this project must be read only through `readEnv` from `src/config/env.ts` (it records which variables the app consults). results.reply:
I converted all six direct reads to `readEnv`, and `npm test` passes (2 tests). The only `process.env` left under `src/` is inside `src/config/env.ts`.

The files changed are `src/db/pool.ts`, `src/features/flags.ts`, `src/jobs/mailer.ts`, `src/server/cors.ts`, `src/server/http.ts` and `src/util/log.ts`. Two of the reads were easy to miss:
- **`src/features/flags.ts`:** the `FORCE_ALL_FEATURES` check read the environment through `globalThis.process?.env`.
